CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to identified content present.

COD.rationale: Content (red) and a presentation pattern are listed for p0/current/n1 and a separate origin/status field is present for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or content-processing condition linked to the identified content's presentation/access is stated.

C.rationale: The report names specific content referents with an attribute (color) and explicit coordinate sets.

D.rationale: An origin/status field is provided separately from the content coordinate listing for the same referent/time.

O.rationale: The content is presented as an explicit spatial pattern (coordinate set), indicating its organization/presentation.
